author: Bobby Grayson
description: merge_record_values does a field-level 3-way merge (one-sided change wins, metadata unions, same-field collision -> later updated_at, edit-after-delete resurrects). 'deciduous merge-record' is registered as a merge driver by init/update/sync via .gitattributes and merge.deciduous.driver. A real two-branch merge of one record file (status change vs metadata.commit) merged cleanly with no markers. 'deciduous sync' repairs files that still carry <<<<<<< markers; --check exits 1 while any remain. 242 unit + 59 integration tests pass, clippy clean.
title: Same-record edits now merge: driver + marker repair verified end to end
